releaseNotes.en-US:
v1.6.1 — What's new:
• Tyre Data Collector role can now sign and approve tyre inspection checklists on both mobile and web.
• Weekly tyre checklist interval reminder is now advisory only — you will see a notice if a vehicle was recently inspected, but you can still fill and submit the checklist.
• Signature is now saved and auto-applied on bulk approvals.
• General stability and permission improvements.
